elements.content:

elements.notes:
ⁱ Production, refinery data withheld to avoid disclosing company proprietary data.
⁳ Apparent consumption = production + imports - exports + adjustments for Government and industry stock changes.
⁴ Price data for United States are average prices at U.S. warehouses.
⁵ Price data for Europe are average prices at European warehouses.
⁶ Net import reliance = imports - exports as a percentage of apparent consumption.
